Title: Fewer than 1% of the HTTP requests fail
Preconditions: The demo service https://quickpizza.grafana.com is reachable
Test Data: Default: 1 VU for 30 s. Report run: 1 VU for 10 s (`-e DURATION=10s`)
Steps: 1. Run `k6 run scripts/smoke.js`. 2. Read the end-of-test summary.
Expected Result: Threshold `http_req_failed: rate<0.01` holds. Less than 1% of all HTTP requests failed (`http_req_failed` rate < 0.01).
